items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: I made enemies with him [Phil Schaap].

ctx.x: - Yeah I played there. We had a misunderstanding. Static, as you might say -- whatever you want to call it. I didn't knock off join in knockin' off or don't playin' the joint, or picketin' it -- whatever you want to say -- goin' on strike against it came the new owner had -- the guy wanted me to play so I played. The other guy wanted me to lay off because it was his thing, although he was in there several times when he had a blackout he was in there. He used to always be outside trying to call people across the…
[Off-tape tells how he evaded the draft by faking a nervous twitch and chewing bubble gum.]
